full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural etching shows a monumental stone stair rising through dense classical masonry toward a domed building. The scene is viewed from a low, shadowed position, giving the central stair a steep ascent from the lower left toward the bright upper middle. High walls, arcades, balconies, and broken arches crowd both sides, their overlapping levels making the architecture feel vast and labyrinthine. Near the top, a large domed structure with columns and smaller attached buildings stands against pale clouds. At the lower right of the stair, a deep round arch opens into black shadow beneath an upper terrace. Another narrow stair and wall passage cross behind it, multiplying possible routes through the space. Tiny human figures at the foot of the steps and near the arch provide scale without changing the architecture's dominance. Stone blocks, carved cornices, railings, and worn surfaces are articulated by fine parallel lines and dense crosshatching. The left foreground remains almost black, while pale stone on the upper facade catches diffuse daylight. Clouds behind the dome are built from softer curved hatch marks and open paper, making the skyline luminous. The image contains no color, yet a wide range of gray values separates sunlit surfaces, midtone walls, and deep recesses. Light enters from above left, grazing the stair edges and tower while darkness pools beneath bridges and within doorways. No readable inscriptions appear. The overall composition is dramatic and complex, drawing the eye upward through repeated arches, stairs, and vertiginous layers of stone.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白建筑蚀刻版画呈现一段宏伟石阶穿过密集古典砖石结构，升向一座圆顶建筑。视点低且处于阴影，使中央台阶从左下方陡升至明亮上方中部。高墙、拱廊、阳台和破拱挤在两侧，重叠楼层让建筑显得庞大又如迷宫。顶部附近，一座有柱廊的大圆顶建筑和相连小楼立于浅云前。台阶右下方，一个深色圆拱开在上层平台下，内部漆黑。另一段窄台阶和墙面通道从其后交错，增加空间中的可能路线。阶梯脚下与拱边的小人物提供尺度，却不改变建筑的主导地位。石块、雕刻檐口、栏杆和磨旧表面由细平行线与密集交叉排线刻画。左侧前景近乎全黑，上方立面的浅石接住漫射日光。圆顶后云层由较柔和的弯曲排线与留白纸面构成，使天际线发亮。图像没有颜色，但宽广灰阶分开受光表面、中间调墙面和深凹处。光从左上方进入，掠过台阶边与塔，黑暗聚在桥下和门洞内。没有可读碑文。整体构图戏剧性强且复杂，引导视线穿过重复拱、阶与眩晕般层叠石建筑向上。
style_prompt_en: Architectural etching relies on fine parallel strokes, dense crosshatching, and untouched paper to build an unusually wide monochrome value range. Repeated arches, stairs, and heavy stone planes overlap in steep perspective, creating complex depth. Upper surfaces remain pale and sharply drafted, while lower recesses gather almost black line density. Cloud forms use softer curved marks to relieve the hard masonry geometry. Light enters obliquely from above, revealing selected edges and leaving deep voids beneath crossings. The overall effect is monumental, intricate, and dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 建筑蚀刻版画依靠细平行线、密集交叉排线和未刻纸白，建立异常宽广的黑白明度范围。重复拱、阶与厚石平面在陡峭透视中重叠，形成复杂纵深。上方表面保持浅色且线描清楚，下方凹处聚集近黑线密度。云形用较柔的弯曲笔痕缓解坚硬石构几何。光从上方斜入，显露局部边缘，让交错结构下留深暗空洞。整体宏伟、繁复而戏剧性强。
theme_en: A monumental stone stair rising toward a domed classical building
theme_zh: 一段宏伟石阶通向圆顶古典建筑
name: Giovanni Battista Piranesi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
